instruction: I want my Ubuntu (GNOME) system to lock automatically when I’m away. Please enable the GNOME automatic screen lock—specifically, make sure org.gnome.desktop.screensaver lock-enabled is set to true. Here’s the guide I’m referring to: https://help.ubuntu.com/lts/ubuntu-help/privacy-screen-lock.html.en

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
